title: Come Home, Little Ones
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose gift is warmth, and tonight Heavenly Father's call toward the north is mercy that leaves the door standing open, the same mercy Willow shows when she calls her hiding brother out from behind the couch.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because mercy is the tenderness that leaves the door standing open. In Willow’s world today: Willow’s little brother knocked her block tower flat and ran to hide behind the couch. Willow looked at the mess for a long, quiet minute. Then she called out softly, ‘You can come out. We can build it again.’ Just like Heavenly Father calling His children home, Willow learned that love does not stay angry forever.
